shortDescription: Manage iRules across different modules on a BIG-IP

options.name: content
options.description: When used instead of B(src), sets the contents of an iRule directly to the specified value. This is for simple values, but can be used with lookup plugins for anything complex or with formatting. Either one of C(src) or C(content) must be provided.

options.name: module
options.description: The BIG-IP module to which the iRule should be added.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: src
options.description: The iRule file to interpret and upload to the BIG-IP. Either one of C(src) or C(content) must be provided.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the iRule should exist or not.
